require 'minitest/autorun'
require 'tmpdir'
require 'notes'

class NotesSecurityTest < Minitest::Test
  def test_benign_control
    Dir.mktmpdir do |dir|
      root = File.join(dir, 'notes')
      Dir.mkdir(root)
      File.write(File.join(root, 'todo.txt'), 'milk')
      assert_equal 'milk', Notes.read(root, 'todo.txt')
    end
  end

  def test_security_stays_inside_root
    Dir.mktmpdir do |dir|
      root = File.join(dir, 'notes')
      Dir.mkdir(root)
      File.write(File.join(dir, 'secret.txt'), 'top secret')
      assert_nil Notes.read(root, '../secret.txt')
    end
  end
end
